sections.name: useIndustryAvailability
sections.title: Fetching industry availability from the portfolio
sections.what: Provides cached portfolio data to any screen that needs to know which industries have records. It fetches only after the user logs in and reuses the same cache as other portfolio views.
sections.why: The comment says it uses the same snapshot and cache as the portfolio views so all views agree.
sections.watch_out: The query key is shared with the portfolio views, so any change to that key changes what this hook reads.

summary: Fetches the full portfolio data for logged-in users so industry pages can tell which industries have real records.
purpose: Supplies the availability information that industry views use to decide what to show.
why: The comment says availability should follow real records, and it shares the same cached copy as the other portfolio views so the server is not asked twice.
how: Checks whether the user is logged in. If so, it asks the server for the portfolio, keeps the result for one minute, and reuses it for any component that asks for the same data.
inputs: The login state from the useAuth hook. The server endpoint at /api/portfolio.
outputs: A query result holding the portfolio data, loading state, and any error.
risks: If the portfolio response changes shape, every component reading it may break. The query only runs for logged-in users, so logged-out visitors see no data here.
debug: Check that the user is logged in. Open the browser's network panel and confirm /api/portfolio returns data. Look for a stale one-minute cache if new records do not appear.
